description: Find the other Macs on the user's local network and SSH into them. Lists every Mac with Remote Login on (Bonjour _ssh._tcp) plus .local hosts in ~/.ssh/config, checks key access, and shows where the sudo password is in Keychain. Use when the user mentions another Mac, "the other computer", a Mac by name, ssh into a machine on the network, the Kimaki fleet, or running something on a different Mac. Also covers adding a new Mac to the network (add-mac.md).
